name: Clayfold
summary: A home goods store and its admin dashboard in one app, with live search, bag and checkout
about: A calm ceramics and textiles store with a sunlit hero where a vase slowly changes shape, a mug steams and a plant sways. Shoppers search with live suggestions, filter and sort the shelf, pick a glaze colour and size, and check out with a PKR bag and promo codes. The built-in admin shows sales, a category donut and recent orders, lets you change order status, edit prices and stock, hide, add or delete products, and see customers. Good for starting a small online shop.
how: Type in the header search: suggestions appear with matches highlighted; use the arrow keys and Enter, or click one.
In Shop, filter by category, colour, size, price, sale or stock, and sort the list; matching words are highlighted.
On a product, choose a glaze colour (the picture re-glazes), a size and a quantity, then Add to bag and watch it float into the bag.
In the bag, change quantities, remove pieces and try SOFTHOME10 or KILNFREE; the total rolls to its new value.
Checkout checks your details, wraps the order with a short sequence and lands on a thank-you page with falling petals.
Open Admin: your new order is at the top of Orders. Change its status, edit stock and prices, hide or delete a product, or add a new one to the shop.
